name: Ring of Self Invisibility
body:
Aura faint illusion; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring looks like a ring of invisibility but there is a 50% chance each time it is used the wearer only turns invisible to himself. Additionally, the wearer is convinced the ring functions properly and will continue to use it even if others try to convince her of its true nature.

A remove curse cast upon the wearer will allow the wearer to see the true nature of the ring and remove it freely though the ring still remains functional.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of invisibility

Identification DC 28
False Identification DC 18
